zh.title: 提交/验证/审查契约分离与默认工具面收口
highlights: 提交、验证、审查彻底分离：deliver_task 收敛为纯安全提交（不再自动验证、不再自动派审查、回执不作质量背书）；新增 review_changes 独立审查入口（固定快照、只读 reviewer、发现持久化）；run_tests 空参数不再默认全量。
默认主控工具面 30→26 件，工具定义体积 -23.2%：galaxy / starflow / plan_task / council_convene 移出默认面按需挂载，新增 orchestration 档整体开放高级编排；/tools 与桌面设置显示真实装配与可见计数。
桌面端：自动更新重做（断点续传、来源校验、损坏运行时自恢复），默认主题改为纯白圣殿（aether-citadel），GitHub MCP 连接改 PAT 优先三步指引；自动记忆形成改为 opt-in（设置 → 行为可开）。

en.title: Commit/verify/review separation and a focused default tool surface
highlights: Commit, verification and review are now fully separate: deliver_task is a pure safe-commit (no auto-verify, no auto-review); review_changes adds independent review (pinned snapshot, read-only reviewer, persisted findings); run_tests no longer defaults to the full suite.

Default main-controller tool surface shrinks 30→26 with 23.2% smaller definitions: galaxy / starflow / plan_task / council_convene mount on demand, a new orchestration preset opens them together; /tools and desktop settings show real assembly counts.

Desktop: the updater is rebuilt (resumable downloads, verified sources, self-recovery of damaged runtimes), the default theme is now aether-citadel, and GitHub MCP onboarding is PAT-first with a three-step guide; automatic memory formation is now opt-in (Settings → Behavior).
